nodes.check: spec-check: FIX_SPEC.md carries, for every live bug, the intended behaviour, the exact edit, and a test that must FAIL on the pre-fix file and PASS after

loop.exit: the same engine, handed the check's real output, repairs the spec; a second failure blocks the node

nodes.sabotage: hand the spec check a bug with no test → it must reject the spec

nodes.check: pytest tests/test_readiness.py -q green, and every test the spec names fails on the pre-fix readiness.py

loop.exit: the same engine, handed the failing test output, repairs; a third failure blocks the node and keeps the diff

nodes.sabotage: revert readiness.py to HEAD → the new tests must go red

nodes.check: pytest tests/test_task_types.py tests/test_mutation_matrix.py -q green, and the mutation matrix still reports 18/18 with 0 missed

loop.exit: the same engine, handed the failing output, repairs; a third failure blocks the node and keeps the diff

nodes.sabotage: revert design_gate.py and intake.js to HEAD → the new tests must go red

nodes.check: verify-check: for each live bug, `git stash` the fix and confirm the new test FAILS, then restore and confirm it passes; then the full suite; a bug whose test passes both ways is reported UNPROVEN

estimate.tokens: 1 spec + 2 builders + 1 verifier, each reading the register and the verifier's findings
estimate.basis: measured today: a 45-issue survey ran 535-540 s; a build node with a bounded file is comparable
